package.name: image_localization_3dgs
package.description: 6-DoF camera relocalization against a pre-built 3D Gaussian Splatting map, using NetVLAD retrieval, 3DGS RGB+depth rendering, MASt3R dense matching and PnP-RANSAC. Subscribes to an image topic and publishes the camera pose.
